title: Prepare Version 14 for Google Play Store (TWA) submission

requirements.text: Update the Play Store packaging/release guidance to explicitly reference Version 14 (not Version 13) everywhere it appears in project state and repository documentation, while keeping all existing URLs, paths, and filenames unchanged unless they are inaccurate.
acceptanceCriteria: No documentation pages or in-app guidance refer to Version 13 as the current release target; they refer to Version 14.

All referenced URLs remain in the `{origin}/...` form, and all referenced repository paths match real filenames/paths in the repo (e.g., `frontend/public/play-store-build-guide.html`, `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, `frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest`).

requirements.text: Ensure the in-app "View Complete Build Guide" action in the Play Store publishing section continues to open the static guide at `/play-store-build-guide.html` in production builds, and that the guide renders correct origin-derived URLs at runtime (manifest, assetlinks, privacy policy).
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the button opens `/play-store-build-guide.html` successfully in a production build.

On the guide page, the displayed Manifest URL is `${window.location.origin}/manifest.webmanifest`, the Digital Asset Links URL is `${window.location.origin}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, and the Privacy Policy URL is `${window.location.origin}/#privacy-policy`.

requirements.text: Harden the Bubblewrap helper script workflow (`frontend/scripts/twa/bubblewrap-release.sh`) for the Version 14 Play Store submission flow so it reliably produces a signed AAB (for Play Console) and, when available, an APK (for testing), and prints explicit next steps for updating `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and redeploying the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `frontend/scripts/twa/bubblewrap-release.sh` completes without errors when Bubblewrap prerequisites are installed, and prints absolute paths to the generated `.aab` (and `.apk` if produced).

The script prints clear instructions that the user must replace `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME` and `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT` in `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, then redeploy so it is accessible at `${ORIGIN_URL}/.well-known/assetlinks.json`.

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI components).
Do not modify immutable hook entrypoints: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Actually uploading or submitting the AAB to Google Play Console (manual external action).
Integrating any third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity.
Adding new payment providers or changing Stripe/bank-transfer business logic.
